items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Sylvester Handy. Eddie Handy's brother, the one who played bass.

ctx.x: Sylvester Handy. Eddie Handy's brother, the one who played bass. Well, John Handy played saxophone and clarinet. Yes, he played clarinet and saxophone.

Yeah, that's John. Yeah. And then there's one who plays guitar whose name I can't think of, Julius. Well, no, no, no. And Sylvester plays bass, but they may call him Eddie, I don't know, his real name is Sylvester.
